# Ndubuisi Marvellous

> Social media strategy, growth, and community lead for fintech, Web3, and tech brands entering or scaling across Africa. 5+ years of experience, 40M+ organic views and impressions, 150K+ followers and members gained, 20K users attributed to an ambassador program.

Ndubuisi Marvellous (thesocialduke) drives social media strategy, community growth, and content for crypto, fintech, SaaS, and emerging tech brands, with a focus on African markets. Past and current work includes Bitget, Binance, and Coinbase (Base).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/): overview, background, and stats.
- [Services](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/services): social media strategy & brand authority, community building & management, partnerships & ecosystem growth (creators, KOLs, ambassadors, partners), community-led growth, and events & experiential marketing. Four-step process: understand the business, build the strategy, execute with the team, measure and improve.
- [Bitget case study](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/bitget): led social media and community for Bitget across multiple African markets: 40M+ organic views and impressions, 150K+ followers and members gained, 20K users attributed to an ambassador program, plus the community operating model and map (B2C channels and B2B relationships: Bitget Builders ambassadors, 100+ KOLs and creators, 200+ P2P merchants, partner events), and Bitget Wallet became Nigeria's #1 downloaded crypto app after OKX exited the market. Also: core programs, community events across Nigeria, Kenya and Ethiopia with highlight videos (P2P Merchant Connect Lagos, Merchant Meetup Nairobi, Crypto Experience Month at the University of Nairobi, Ethiopia Blockchain Week, El Clasico Watch Party Lagos, Community Meetup Nairobi). Press: Techpression covered the P2P session he led at Bitget Community Education Day in Lagos (September 2025): https://techpression.com/bitget-hosts-community-education-day-in-lagos-eyes-africas-crypto-future/
- [Base (Coinbase) case study](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/base-southern-africa): coached Base's Southern Africa ambassador and creator network into a consistent source of sharper, on-brand video content, including AI-directed campaign films.
- [Binance case study](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/binance-street-interviews): making complex products easier to understand: short-form street-interview videos for Binance Africa that explained crypto in plain language, made for Instagram and TikTok.
- [Contact](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/contact): email, resume download, social links and an embedded booking calendar. Open to full-time and contract roles, and available to relocate.
